openssh
=======

.. tip:: Ingestion into Splunk.

   **``linux:openssh``**

   * name_rex: ``\.jsonl$``
   * path_suffix: ``openssh``
   * sourcetype: ``linux:openssh``
   * host_rex: ``([\w\.-]+?)--``
   * artifact: ``openssh``

Description
-----------

Parse openssh authorized\_keys,known\_hosts,private\_keys,public\_keys from UAC [root] using Dissect plugin
